name: Box Out
idea: When a shot goes up, find your player, put your back on them, then grab the rebound.
why: If you keep your player behind you, they can’t get to the ball. The ball bounces to you instead of them.
tryit: Play “Box out” with a partner: when the coach yells “Shot!”, turn, find your partner, and keep them behind you for three seconds.

frames.say: This time you’re on defense! {1} has the ball. {X4} and {X5} step toward the middle to watch the ball.
{1} shoots and misses! {X4} and {X5} turn, find their player, and push back with their backs. That’s a *box out*.
The ball bounces off the rim, and {X5} grabs it. {5} never had a chance!
